sources.text: Unsalted, rindless fresh cheese drained on rush mats; Ligurian version is ewe's milk, southern Italian ones also goat or cow
Unsalted, rindless fresh cheese drained on rush mats; Ligurian version is ewe's milk, southern Italian ones also goat or cow

facts.v: Milk at 32–38 °C with liquid calf or lamb rennet; the curd is set in a rush basket (fascera) and drained into a flat, thin shape; unsalted
Recognised as a traditional regional product in Puglia, Calabria and Liguria; the Calabrian version is a Sila and Sibari-plain speciality
